notes.title: 【V1.3.2】Millennium Edition Update Change Log - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings, gamers from Planet W!

As spring arrives, we have received some bug reports from the people of Planet W. We've fixed these bugs to perfect your experience. Here's a list of the fixes.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where players could bypass constellation collection even when their main wish had been updated.
 Fixed a display error in a tutorial text in the traditional Chinese version.
 Fixed several minor bugs.


If you encounter any other issues or would like to talk to us, feel free to drop us an e-mail at contact@perfectdaystudio.com

W people's souls are all determined by W people's minds!

notes.title: 【V1.3.1】Bug Fixes Change Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, gamers from Planet W!

In the past month since the localization update of "A Perfect Day", we have caught and fixed various issues in the game, aiming to bring you a more perfect experience. Please check them out below!

Optimizations and Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where the right joystick was not working in the Momants interface on the phone.
Fixed the pointer malfunction when eating dumplings in certain scenes.
Fixed the issue where the camera flickered when entering Ol' Ge's UFO under certain circumstances.
Fixed the issue where the pointer disappeared when opening the map or Urban Lament.
Fixed the incorrect button prompt positioning in certain interfaces.
Fixed the issue where auto-playing certain scenes would skip some voices.
Fixed the issue where the button prompts would appear on the bottom right corner when opening the game for the first time with a controller.
Fixed the display issue of the shortcut menu in English.
Fixed the occasional freezing issue when skipping time spans by playing yo-yo.
Fixed the overlapped display of button prompts in certain scenes.
Added the function to display the amount of money you have on the top left corner in the corner store.


If you discover any other issues or wish to communicate with us, please email us at contact@perfectdaystudio.com
